topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the class and outlines the focus of the lecture on immune activation and resolution.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the innate immune system detects infections and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory responses, cell recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte recruitment to inflamed tissue and how unchecked inflammatory signals can lead to systemic disease.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammation is shut down, how damaged tissue is repaired, and how persistent stimuli lead to chronic inflammation or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and introduces the topic for the next session.
